properties.name: management.health.cassandra.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Cassandra health check.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.compression
properties.description: Compression supported by the Cassandra binary protocol.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.config
properties.description: Location of the configuration file to use.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.connection.connect-timeout
properties.description: Timeout to use when establishing driver connections.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.connection.init-query-timeout
properties.description: Timeout to use for internal queries that run as part of the initialization process, just after a connection is opened.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.contact-points
properties.description: Cluster node addresses in the form 'host:port', or a simple 'host' to use the configured port.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.controlconnection.timeout
properties.description: Timeout to use for control queries.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.keyspace-name
properties.description: Keyspace name to use.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.local-datacenter
properties.description: Datacenter that is considered "local". Contact points should be from this datacenter.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.password
properties.description: Login password of the server.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.pool.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Heartbeat interval after which a message is sent on an idle connection to make sure it's still alive.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.pool.idle-timeout
properties.description: Idle timeout before an idle connection is removed.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.port
properties.description: Port to use if a contact point does not specify one.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.consistency
properties.description: Queries consistency level.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.page-size
properties.description: How many rows will be retrieved simultaneously in a single network round-trip.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.serial-consistency
properties.description: Queries serial consistency level.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.throttler.drain-interval
properties.description: How often the throttler attempts to dequeue requests. Set this high enough that each attempt will process multiple entries in the queue, but not delay requests too much.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.throttler.max-concurrent-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of requests that are allowed to execute in parallel.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.throttler.max-queue-size
properties.description: Maximum number of requests that can be enqueued when the throttling threshold is exceeded.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.throttler.max-requests-per-second
properties.description: Maximum allowed request rate.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.throttler.type
properties.description: Request throttling type.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.request.timeout
properties.description: How long the driver waits for a request to complete.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.schema-action
properties.description: Schema action to take at startup.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.session-name
properties.description: Name of the Cassandra session.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.ssl.bundle
properties.description: SSL bundle name.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL support.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.ssl.verify-hostname
properties.description: Whether to perform hostname verification.

properties.name: spring.cassandra.username
properties.description: Login user of the server.
